adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent`, the calendar is selected via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, otherwise it falls back to `"primary"` (`calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`). The diff also explicitly supports `DestinationCalendar` entries without `credentialId` (see `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`: `if (destination.credentialId) ... else ... createEvent(c, event)`), meaning for those destinations the `find(...credentialId...)` will not match and Google events will be created on the primary calendar instead of the destination's `externalId`. Additionally, `CalendarManager.createEvent` now returns `externalId` only from the optional parameter passed by `EventManager` (`createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`), but the null-credentialId branch does not pass that externalId, so `EventManager` will record references with `externalCalendarId: result.externalId` as `undefined`, losing the destination calendar id for later operations.
